title: Out-of-the-Box Tabular Foundation Models for Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.12491v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Bayesian optimization is widely used in active learning loops for materials science. Gaussian processes serve as the de-facto surrogate model family, but require task-dependent kernel choices and can lack the modeling capacity for complex relationships. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have recently emerged as the state-of-the-art for predictive tasks on structured data, without requiring bespoke kernels or hyperparameter tuning. We evaluate two TFMs, TabPFN and TabICL, as out-of-the-box surrogate models on two standard materials science benchmarks, comparing against a large field of baselines encompassing Gaussian processes, random forests, and CatBoost. Our findings indicate that TFMs are highly competitive surrogate models across the two benchmarks, without task-specific training for active learning or GP kernel selection. Our results motivate developing TFMs further as surrogates for active learning in materials discovery.

translated_title: 材料发现中贝叶斯优化的开箱即用表格基础模型
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化被广泛应用于材料科学的主动学习循环中。高斯过程是事实上的代理模型家族，但需要依赖具体任务的核函数选择，并且可能缺乏对复杂关系的建模能力。表格基础模型（TFMs）最近已成为结构化数据预测任务的最先进方法，无需定制核函数或超参数调优。我们评估了两个表格基础模型 TabPFN 和 TabICL，在两个标准的材料科学基准上作为开箱即用的代理模型，并与涵盖高斯过程、随机森林和 CatBoost 的大量基线方法进行比较。我们的研究结果表明，TFMs 在这两个基准上都是极具竞争力的代理模型，且无需针对主动学习的任务特定训练或 GP 核函数选择。我们的结果为将 TFMs 进一步发展为材料发现中主动学习的代理模型提供了动力。
tldr: 该论文证明 TabPFN 和 TabICL 等表格基础模型可以作为开箱即用的代理模型，在材料发现的贝叶斯优化中媲美高斯过程等传统方法，无需核函数选择或任务特定训练。
en_tdlr: Tabular foundation models (TabPFN and TabICL) serve as highly competitive out-of-the-box surrogate models for Bayesian optimization in materials discovery, rivaling Gaussian processes without requiring kernel selection or task-specific training.
